newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said it has maintained its buy rating on Brazilian federal telecoms giant Telebras and its attractive rating for the firm's Sao Paulo state unit Telesp.
-- The brokerage, citing a new general telecoms law sent to Congress on Thursday, said both firms are likely to benefit from the break-up and privatization of Telebras authorized by the bill.

-- But it prefers Telebras to Telesp because the risk from the selloff to Telebras' holding company is diminished because the bill requires cash payment and a new regulatory framework should further define the sale process, it added.
-- "This should allow Telebras to outperform Telesp going forward," Bear Stearns said.
-- Telebras' ADR was up 7/8 at 73 3/4 in New York while its preferred was up 0.50 reais at 76.60 reais and its voting common was 1.30 reais higher at 69.50 reais in Sao Paulo at 1601 local/1301 EST.
-- Telesp preferred was up 3.00 reais at 193 reais while its common was off one real at 187 reais at 1602 local/1302 EST on the Sao Paulo stock market.
